# Appeal Edge

> Independent Amazon seller suspension appeal consultancy. Every case is read by a specialist from a panel with more than 20 years of combined Amazon experience. Cases are reviewed individually and pricing is provided after that review, not published as a fixed rate.

## Key Facts
- Appeal Edge is run by three founders: Khushi Narwal (COO), Apeksha Namdev (CEO), and Aayush Namdev (CTO), with Likith as Head of Operations
- 300+ suspended accounts reinstated
- Regions served: US, UK, EU, Canada, Mexico, Australia and India
- Cases are worked by a panel of Amazon specialists with more than 20 years of combined experience, not named publicly since they work independently
- Every case is reviewed and assigned to the specialist who fits it. That same specialist stays in direct contact with you throughout
- Pricing is not published. Case review is free, and pricing is discussed only after the case is reviewed
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Amazon.com, Inc.
- Independent consultancy, not a law firm. Content is general guidance, not legal advice

## Suspension Types Covered
- Inauthentic and counterfeit complaints
- Performance metrics: Order Defect Rate, Late Shipment Rate, Valid Tracking Rate
- Intellectual property, trademark, and copyright complaints
- Related account suspensions
- Listing policy violations and restricted category issues
- Review manipulation suspicions
- Dropshipping policy violations
- Used sold as new and condition complaints

## How a case is handled
- Step 1: Review the suspension notice and identify the actual violation type and root cause
- Step 2: Cross reference the case against Amazon's current policy requirements
- Step 3: Draft a case specific Plan of Action naming the root cause, the corrective action already taken, and the preventive measures going forward
- Step 4: Check the draft for generic language, vague claims, and missing specifics before submission

## Services
- [Amazon Seller Suspension Appeal Service](https://www.appeal-edge.com/amazon-appeal-service/): A case specific appeal built by a specialist panel with 20+ years of combined experience. Free review, price shared once we know what your case needs.
- [Amazon Plan of Action Writing Service](https://www.appeal-edge.com/amazon-plan-of-action-writing-service/): Already know your violation type and just need the Plan of Action written right. A case specific POA, checked before it goes anywhere near Amazon.
- [Amazon IP Complaint Removal Service](https://www.appeal-edge.com/amazon-ip-complaint-removal-service/): Trademark, copyright, and counterfeit complaints removed the way Amazon actually reviews them. Free case review before anything is charged.
- [Amazon Seller Account Suspended in India](https://www.appeal-edge.com/amazon-appeal-service-india/): Appeal help for India based Amazon sellers, on WhatsApp and email, in your time zone. Free case review before anything is charged.

- [Amazon Fair Pricing Violation: How to Appeal](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-fair-pricing-policy-violation-appeal/): A fair pricing violation flags your price as significantly higher than a recent reference price, not as a pricing strategy error. Here is how to appeal it.
- [Amazon Valid Tracking Rate: The 95% Threshold](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-valid-tracking-rate-suspension/): It's usually a carrier problem, not a shipping one. Amazon expects Valid Tracking Rate near 95%, and here's what to fix when a scan is missing.
- [Amazon Account Health Rating Too Low? Fix It](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-account-health-rating-low-deactivation-appeal/): An Account Health Rating under 100 puts your account at risk of deactivation. Here is how the score works and how to raise it before Amazon acts.
- [Amazon Order Defect Rate Too High? Fix It](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-order-defect-rate-too-high-fix/): Order Defect Rate combines three separate metrics into one number, and moving it back under 1 percent takes different action for each.
- [Amazon Review Manipulation Suspension Appeal](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-review-manipulation-suspension-appeal/): Amazon review manipulation covers more than buying fake reviews. Here's exactly what gets classified as manipulation, and what the appeal needs to prove.
- [Amazon Restricted Products Suspension Appeal](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-restricted-products-suspension-appeal/): A product research tool can surface a promising product without ever flagging that the category is gated. Here's what makes a product restricted.
- [Amazon Velocity Review Suspension Appeal](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-velocity-review-suspension-appeal/): Amazon's velocity review flag can trigger from a sudden, legitimate burst of reviews. Here's exactly what the flag measures, and what clears it.
- [Amazon Section 3 Suspension: How to Respond](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-section-3-suspension-appeal/): Amazon Section 3 notices cite the Business Solutions Agreement but rarely say what's flagged. Here's what Section 3 covers and how to find the real issue.
- [Amazon Used Sold as New Suspension: Appeal](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-used-sold-as-new-suspension-appeal/): A used sold as new complaint can come from a unit you never touched. Here's exactly what triggers this suspension and what your appeal needs to prove.
- [Amazon High ODR (Order Defect Rate) Suspension](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-high-odr-suspension-appeal/): A high Order Defect Rate suspension is about a measurable pattern, not one bad review. Here's how to build a Plan of Action that proves it.

- [Amazon ASIN Suspended: How to Appeal](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-asin-suspended-listing-removed-appeal/): A suspended ASIN is a listing level action, not an account suspension. Here is how to tell which you have, what Amazon wants and how to appeal.
- [How to Read an Amazon Suspension Notice](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/how-to-read-amazon-suspension-notice/): Your suspension notice already says what Amazon wants. Here is how to find the violation type, the evidence it asks for and what to do next.
- [Amazon Account Suspended Before First Sale](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-account-suspended-before-first-sale/): Suspended before you ever made a sale on Amazon. Here is why that happens on new accounts, often tied to verification or Section 3, and how to respond.
- [Amazon Appeal With No Sales History](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-appeal-no-sales-history-new-account/): Every Amazon appeal guide says to show your metrics improved, which is impossible with almost no orders. Here is what a new account can point to instead.
- [Amazon India Seller Account Suspended](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-india-seller-account-suspended-appeal/): Amazon.in seller account suspended. GST documentation, courier tracking, and account structure work differently than Amazon US or UK. Here is what matters.
- [Amazon Suspended With FBA Inventory Stranded](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-suspended-fba-inventory-stranded-storage-fees/): Your Amazon account is suspended and your FBA stock is stuck in a warehouse while storage fees keep accruing. Here is what happens to that inventory.
- [Is Appealing an Amazon Suspension Worth It](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/is-amazon-appeal-worth-it-small-seller/): Turning over $5,000 to $10,000 a month and suspended on Amazon. An honest look at when appealing is worth the time and cost, and when it genuinely is not.
- [New Amazon Seller Account Suspended](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/new-amazon-seller-account-suspended/): A new Amazon seller account gets suspended more often than an established one because it has no track record yet. Here is why, and the first moves to make.
- [New Amazon Account After Suspension? Don't](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/should-i-open-new-amazon-account-after-suspension/): Thinking about opening a new Amazon account after a suspension instead of appealing. Here is why that almost always ends worse, and what to do instead.
- [Write Your Own Amazon Appeal, No Lawyer](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/write-your-own-amazon-appeal-without-a-lawyer/): Hiring help is not always an option. Here is exactly how to write a genuinely strong Amazon plan of action yourself, step by step, with no lawyer or agency.
- [Amazon Suspended and Holding Your Funds](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-account-suspended-funds-held-release/): A suspended account does not always mean funds are gone. Here is why Amazon holds disbursements, the 90 day timeline, and how reinstatement releases them.
- [Amazon Final Decision Email: What It Means](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-appeal-final-decision-account-not-reinstated/): A final decision email feels like the end, but it usually is not. Here is what the notice actually means and the paths still open after it.
- [Amazon Seller Account Suspended: What to Do](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-seller-account-suspended-what-to-do/): A suspended Amazon account is not dead. Here is the exact sequence to follow in the first 24 hours, and where to go next based on your violation type.
- [Amazon Seller Verification Failed: Fix It](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-seller-identity-verification-failed-appeal/): Video or document verification failures are usually a mismatch problem, not a fraud accusation. Here is what Amazon checks and how to fix a failed verification.
- [How Long Does an Amazon Appeal Take](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/how-long-amazon-appeal-takes-reinstatement-timeline/): Amazon appeal timelines vary by violation type and review queue. Here is what to expect at each stage, and when a delay signals a real problem.
- [Amazon Not Responding to Your Appeal? Escalate](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-not-responding-to-appeal-escalation/): Escalate an Amazon appeal that has stopped getting real responses through Account Health Support and specialist routing. Here is the actual path.
- [Amazon Appeal Rejected? What to Change](https://www.appeal-edge.com/blog/amazon-appeal-rejected-twice-what-to-do/): Amazon appeal rejected once or twice? It means something specific is still missing. Here's exactly what to change before you resubmit.
